criteria.evidence: The held-claim, distinct-verifier and verified-M safety checks remain enforced; no path was found that records merged without the required evidence.

A P-adopted record cannot resume in a process with changed TERM_SESSION_ID: close-prepare and integrate-gate both fail pre-mutation because stored gate environment provenance is compared with the new process. A moved prepared I also has no retained reprepare operation.

After adopted report P, a gate rerun at M succeeds and clears evidence.finalized; the adopted P proof then requires that cleared live finalization and blocks close-prepare and every recovery mutation, so mandatory P->E->H cannot complete.

Exact actual-M gates, C/source/M manifests, fresh M review and verification, durable logs/history and recursive checkout proofs remain implemented. The new blocker concerns evidence/artifact lifecycle after M finalization.

Member identities, verdicts and findings are retained when correctly placed, but a panel receipt with an unresolved top-level major and PASS members is accepted and returned with no findings; aggregate consistency is not enforced.
